comment:
* A watcher which makes stats on the incoming binder transaction, if the amount of some type of
 * transactions exceeds the threshold, the listener will be notified.

variables.name: mEnabled
variables.comment: * Whether or not this watcher is enabled.

variables.name: mListener
variables.comment:
* The listener to be notified in case the amount of some type of transactions exceeds the
     * threshold.

variables.name: mHeavyHitterCandiates
variables.comment:
* The candidates that could be the heavy hitters, so we track their hashcode and the actual
     * containers in this map.

variables.name: mCachedCandidateList
variables.comment: * The cache to receive the list of candidates (consists of the hashcode of heavy hitters).

variables.name: mCachedCandidateFrequencies
variables.comment: * The cache to receive the frequencies of each items in {@link #mCachedCandidateList}.

variables.name: mCachedCandidateSet
variables.comment: * The cache set to host the candidates.

variables.name: mCachedCandidateContainers
variables.comment: * The cache set to host the containers of candidates.

variables.name: mCachedCandidateContainersIndex
variables.comment: * The index to the {@link #mCachedCandidateContainers}, denote the first available slot

variables.name: mInputSize
variables.comment: * The input size, should be {@link #mTotalInputSize} - validation size.

variables.name: mCurrentInputSize
variables.comment: * The number of inputs so far

variables.name: mThreshold
variables.comment: * The threshold to be considered as heavy hitters

variables.name: mBatchStartTimeStamp
variables.comment: * The timestamp of the start of current tracing.

variables.name: EPSILON
variables.comment: * The tolerance within which is approximately equal

methods.name: public static BinderCallHeavyHitterWatcher getInstance()
methods.comment: * Return the instance of the watcher

methods.comment:
* Configure the parameters.
     *
     * @param enable    Whether or not to enable the watcher
     * @param batchSize The number of binder transactions it needs to receive before the conclusion
     * @param threshold The threshold to determine if some type of transactions are too many, it
     *                  should be a value between (0.0f, 1.0f]
     * @param listener  The callback interface

methods.name: private void resetInternalLocked(@Nullable final BinderCallHeavyHitterListener listener, @Nullable final HeavyHitterSketch<Integer> sketch, final int inputSize, final int batchSize, final float threshold, final int capacity)
public void onTransaction(final int callerUid, @NonNull final Class clazz, final int code)
methods.comment:
* Called on incoming binder transaction
     *
     * @param callerUid The UID of the binder transaction's caller
     * @param clazz     The class of the Binder object serving the transaction
     * @param code      The binder transaction code
